scope: Real Windows Git clone, project workspace and credential failure regression
changes: Keep native absolute filesystem sources in the unnamed managed slot instead of interpreting a Windows drive as a URL scheme.

Use a short exclusively created staging path on the destination volume; nested repository staging stays under the authorized task anchor, is Git-excluded and is atomically renamed. Never remove a competing published target.
Enable core.longpaths for Windows clone and the newly created repository only; do not change global Git configuration. This does not promise arbitrary Windows Git working-directory lengths.
limitations: The earlier 13-pass/1-fail record preserves the actual GIT_DIR-too-big failure after merely enabling core.longpaths.
Credential classification uses an owned native Git fixture; real clone, branch, reuse and PostgreSQL orchestration use actual installed Git and embedded PostgreSQL.
No remote provider or user credentials were required.
